ground_truth.description: _claimFees() sweeps the entire balance of `token0`/`token1` after `collectFees()`, stealing rewards if `rewardToken` matches `token0` or `token1`. Impact: Bribe contract receives staking rewards instead of fees.
ground_truth.root_cause: _claimFees() sweeps the entire balance of `token0`/`token1` after `collectFees()`, stealing rewards if `rewardToken` matches `token0` or `token1`. Impact: Bribe contract receives staking rewards instead of fees.
ground_truth.attack_scenario: A test deposits 10 HYBR rewards, adds 0.1 HYBR fees, and `claimFees()` sweeps all 10.1 HYBR to the bribe contract.
ground_truth.fix_description: Transfer only the difference in balance before/after `collectFees()`; add access control to `claimFees`. Status: Mitigation confirmed.

vulnerabilities.explanation: _claimFees calls clPool.collectFees() then unconditionally reads the full token0/token1 balances of the gauge and forwards them to internal_bribe. When rewardToken == token0 or token1, any unclaimed staking rewards already held by the gauge are included in the sweep.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: 1. Gauge holds rewardToken (which equals token0). 2. Attacker (or anyone) calls claimFees(). 3. Entire rewardToken balance is approved and sent to IBribe.notifyRewardAmount instead of only the newly collected fees. Staking rewards are permanently diverted to the bribe contract.
vulnerabilities.suggested_fix: Record token0/token1 balances before collectFees(), subtract to obtain only the delta, and transfer only that amount. Add access control (onlyDistribution or similar) to claimFees.

prediction.overall_explanation: The implementation of _claimFees sweeps full token balances rather than the incremental fees collected, allowing reward tokens to be stolen when they share an address with token0/token1. The function is publicly callable.
